messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-9821 fired — redis-queue-length > 200k for service=runtime-router :exclamation:
pagerduty: Incident PD-9821 created and paged on-call. Priority: P1.
maria.nguyen: acked PD-9821 — taking first look. Seeing continuous backlog across all regions. Queue latency spiked ~10m ago.
jon.chen: confirmed — alerts show autoscaler scaling events stopped 9m ago and queue consumer lag rising. Also seeing 503s in router logs.
sasha.patel: tagging @kevin.lopez — can you check autoscaler controller logs? suspect controller OOM or leader election thrash.
kevin.lopez: on it. pulling controller logs now. quick tail: 
```
I0314 12:12:10 controller.go:312] processing scale request
E0314 12:12:11 controller.go:418] panic: runtime: out of memory
... goroutine 1 [running]:
```
kevin.lopez: yep controller crashed repeatedly and restarted, leader lease lost -> no scaling happening. rolling into pod to check crash cause.
maria.nguyen: good catch. mitigation plan: 1) scale up workers manually to burn down backlog 2) isolate faulty controller and redeploy stable image 3) reduce ingress traffic to critical customers if needed.
jon.chen: how much manual scale do we need? current queue 210k, normal drain rate 20k/min with full workers. we need +6x workers.
sasha.patel: I can run a manual scale while kevin investigates. command: `kubectl scale deployment runtime-workers --replicas=60 -n prod`
kevin.lopez: do it. also open a rollback window if new controller image rolled last deploy. checking deploy history: last deploy 03:01 today changed memory manager flags.
maria.nguyen: rolling manual scale now. exec output: `scaled deployment "runtime-workers" to 60` :rocket:
ir-bot: automation note: scaling triggered by runbook manual step.
jon.chen: traffic shaping on CDN side — enabling probational 30% request shed for non-verified keys to reduce new work queue. give me 1m to push.
sasha.patel: pushed CDN rule. docs: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/autoscale#queue-sat
kevin.lopez: controller logs show OOM due to mem leak in metrics aggregator. I'll pin controller to previous image and restart. `kubectl set image deployment/autoscaler controller=registry/redwood/autoscaler:v1.9.2 -n infra`
kevin.lopez: image rolled, controller pods are stable. no more crash loops. watching leader election.
maria.nguyen: queue drain rate improving. backlog down to 140k after 6m. 503s reduced, error budget alert cleared for runtime-router for some customers.
jon.chen: manual scale seems sufficient for now. we should let workers scale down once backlog < 10k.
sasha.patel: logging note: collecting stack traces and heap profiles from crashed controller pods for postmortem. filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4213
maria.nguyen: escalating to SRE lead for postmortem and SLA customer comms. @kevin.lopez please add root cause analysis and mitigation timeline.
kevin.lopez: will do. initial RCA points: memory leak in metrics aggregator introduced in v1.10.0, leader election crash -> autoscaler unavailable -> queue saturation.
ir-bot: PD-9821 status updated to RESOLVED by maria.nguyen. Resolution: manual scale + rollback to v1.9.2 + CDN shed.
maria.nguyen: handoff to night on-call: @jon.chen will monitor queue drain and ensure nodes autoscale back normally. If backlog increases >50k or controller restarts, page SRE lead.
jon.chen: got it. I'll escalate if anything regresses. leaving notes in incident doc: https://internal.redwood/incidents/PD-9821
maria.nguyen: thanks everyone. postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
